checker.review_scope: Complete output/CLI and gap_check interface excerpts plus exact final transport-receipt insertion; full native checker proof review remains separately assigned.

checks: Request and root gate bind the exact driver, producer, checker, configuration and supervisor, one native preparation, zero optimizer calls, no retries and the declared limits.
Every gate dependency is byte/hash checked before execution and again after all four phases.
All six worker/owner directories are distinct, absent before invocation and non-nested; terminal output is exclusive-create.
The producer controls/prepare CLI, required PASS strings, source/config references and native-model flags match the complete frozen producer.
Each producer owner requires explicit zero child return, reaped child and stopped process group under 15/135-second ownership.

The independent checker is a separate process under the pinned supervisor. Controls use 10/15 seconds; complete replay uses 120/135 seconds. Its CLI and required no-native/import flags match the inspected checker output.

The driver compares total terms, family counts/terms, complete original-message preservation, full row-key digest, exact gap_check dictionary and complete model raw identity across producer and checker.
The independent restoration must equal the pinned 39,512,348-byte parent. Final status is granted only after all four phases and rehashing all dependencies.
Finally retains existing report, owner, error, restoration, model/suffix/row-ledger archives, initial/owned receipts, supervisor and stages even when a later phase fails.
The driver has a 420-second acceptance limit, no automatic rebuild, query, solver, parameter sweep or retry.
qualifications: This is a complete driver source review and targeted producer/checker interface comparison, not a duplicate full mathematical review of the independent native checker.
The top-level elapsed limit is an acceptance bound; the actual phase processes are bounded by the reused process-group supervisors and the later CI job timeout.
Actual configuration/request/gate and successful native preparation plus separate replay remain required.
